description: Competitive intelligence on French public procurement: who wins contracts on the SAME CPV segments as a given company (SIREN): top rival contractors over the last 3 years with counts, amounts and shared segments. From official DECP open data. Paid via x402 ($0.02 in USDC or EURC). Names are served for legal persons proven by their Sirene legal category only: a sole proprietorship, a group of natural persons or a category in doubt never has its name served and keeps its SIREN or SIRET, the omissions counted without identity in ecartes, over the entries the response serves (rule R1). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.

api_key.description: Optional Sirenic API key (srn_live_…) paying from credits. Ignored when x_payment is provided. See server instructions.

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value); omit it to get the quote.

name: get_company_procurement_competitors

payment_required.description: True for an x402 payment quote instead of data.

resultat.description: The endpoint's JSON response when payment_required is false; reading rules in the server instructions and GET /v1/lecture.
